integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone finite checks are included. Finite checks do not establish asymptotic or infinite-parameter claims; those rely on the proof. Only same-model scientific review is reported.
scientific_limitations: The range is unconditional over all positive shape parameters and all real tilt parameters at fixed integer n at least two. It does not classify fixed-mean or fixed-shape regions. The Bernoulli/TV asymptotics assume fixed nonzero tilt, fixed n and fixed alpha, with beta tending to infinity. Exact endpoints are not attained. Historical priority is best-knowledge, not independent certification.
title: Sharp binomial-dispersion spectrum and rare-count Bernoulli transition in the bimodal beta-binomial family
